display.name: FuseScope Collector
display.description: Health of the FuseScope collectors from their own telemetry: what the receivers accept and refuse, what the exporters send and drop, export queues, the memory limiter, ClickHouse insert latency, rows and errors per table, CPU, memory and restarts. Scope by collector from the variable bar.

display.name: collector
display.description: Collector host (the pod's name on Kubernetes)

spec.queryValue:
SELECT JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name') AS `host.name`
FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4_1day
WHERE metric_name = 'otelcol_process_uptime'
    AND JSONExtractString(labels, 'service.name') = 'fusescope-collector'
GROUP BY `host.name`

display.name: Spans accepted
display.description: Spans per second the receivers accepted, averaged over the range.

display.name: Log records accepted
display.description: Log records per second the receivers accepted, averaged over the range.

display.name: Spans refused
display.description: Spans per second the receivers refused, averaged over the range; most often under memory pressure.

display.name: Peak export queue
display.description: The fullest exporter queue at its peak over the range, in batches.

display.name: Memory (RSS) now
display.description: Resident memory of the largest collector, at the latest point.

display.name: RUM policy age now
display.description: Seconds since the RUM ingest policy was received, at the latest point; empty while none is held.

display.name: Spans accepted by receiver
display.description: Per second, by receiver (otlp, rum).

display.name: Log records accepted by receiver
display.description: Per second, by receiver.

display.name: Metric points accepted by receiver
display.description: Per second, by receiver.

display.name: Sent by exporter
display.description: Per second, by exporter: spans, log records and metric points.

display.name: Refused by receiver
display.description: Per second. Refusals tell the sender to retry; under memory pressure they come from the memory limiter.

display.name: Failed by receiver
display.description: Per second: requests a receiver could not process.

display.name: Failed to send by exporter
display.description: Per second: items an exporter dropped after its retries. Empty until the first such failure.

display.name: Memory limiter accepted
display.description: Per second, by signal. A drop here with refusals above is the memory limiter at work.

display.name: Queue size by exporter
display.description: Batches waiting, by exporter and signal. A queue that keeps growing means the destination is slower than the input.

display.name: Queue capacity by exporter
display.description: The most the queue holds; at capacity new data is refused.

display.name: Requests in flight by exporter
display.description: Export requests being sent.

display.name: Processor throughput
display.description: Items per second into and out of each processor.

display.name: Insert latency by table (p95)
display.description: 95th percentile of one insert attempt, by table, retries included.

display.name: Insert latency
display.description: 50th, 95th and 99th percentiles of one insert attempt, all tables.

display.name: Rows inserted by table
display.description: Per second, rows in confirmed inserts; a retry ClickHouse deduplicates adds no new rows.

display.name: Insert errors by table
display.description: Per second, failed insert attempts by table and outcome (retryable or permanent). Empty until the first failure.

display.name: CPU
display.description: CPU seconds per second, by collector.

display.name: Memory (RSS)
display.description: Resident memory, by collector.

display.name: Go heap
display.description: Heap allocated, by collector.

display.name: Uptime
display.description: Seconds since start, by collector: a drop is a restart.
